items.title: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch software flaws exposed by Anthropic's Mythos
items.summary: Bank of America has hired an army of external contractors to help it patch software vulnerabilities exposed by advanced artificial intelligence models including Anthropic's Mythos , the bank's CEO, Brian Moynihan , told CNBC on Wednesday.

items.title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue beats expectations by $909 million
items.summary: Morgan Stanley posted third-quarter results that beat expectations on blockbuster results in its equities trading franchise.

items.title: Bank of America shares drop after third-quarter revenue miss and regulatory penalty
items.summary: Bank of America on Wednesday posted a sharp profit decline after being hit with a $1.2 billion penalty by U.S. regulators, while revenue also disappointed after trading operations generated about $750 million less than expected.

items.title: China's exports and imports surge past expectations in September
items.summary: BEIJING — China's exports grew by 36.3% in September from a year ago, their fastest pace since February, according to official data released Wednesday.

items.title: UK economy grew 0.1% in August, beating expectations
items.summary: The U.K. economy grew by a better-than-expected 0.1% in the month to August, with production growth offsetting weak output in services and construction.

items.title: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
items.summary: U.S. consumers are in the midst of one of the longest stretches of elevated inflation of the past century.

items.title: Consumer prices rose 3.7% annually in September as gas prices skyrocket
items.summary: September brought little relief to the accelerating cost of living, as consumer prices increased again and kept the inflation rate well above the Federal Reserve's goal.

items.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
items.summary: BANGKOK — The International Monetary Fund has raised its forecast for global growth this year as the AI-driven investment boom helps offset some of the impact from surging energy costs, while warning that economic resilience could be nearing its breaking point.
